lines:
flowchart TD
    A[Open QA workspace] --> B[Load QA jobs with derived state]
    B --> C[Filter by state tag task or design link]
    C --> D{User action}
    D -->|Edit job| E[Update name description command metadata links tags or enabled flag]
    D -->|Delete job| F[Remove QA job definition after confirmation]
    D -->|Run selected or visible| G[Submit explicit ids or current query]
    G --> H[Show integrated console output]
    H --> I[Merge run summary and latest job states]
    D -->|Open history| J[Inspect qa_runs and qa_job_runs evidence]
    E --> B
    F --> B
    I --> B
